source_snapshot.procedure: Confirm SUT configuration, clear logs, check the LED status if PWM High state, then collect results/photos and inspect unexpected dmesg, syslog and SEL evidence.
source_snapshot.criteria: Check LED status if PWM High state
source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: A person must visually observe and photograph the physical PSU LED while it is in the PWM-high condition.

original_test_intent.purpose: Visually verify the identified CRPS PSU LED's specified behavior while the exact owner-defined PWM-high phase or state is active.
original_test_intent.target: The physical LED on the positively identified target PSU and the exact PWM behavior definition applicable to its platform/specification revision; not a generic host LED, BMC status field or guessed control pin.
original_test_intent.scope: One qualified establishment of the approved PWM-high condition, direct visual observation correlated to that condition, and supporting PSU/platform health evidence. The source does not authorize generic PWM electrical injection or configuration writes.
original_test_intent.operation: A qualified operator verifies the target and approved PWM definition/setup, establishes or confirms the documented high phase through the platform-approved method, records the stimulus/configuration state and synchronized LED photo/video, returns the setup to its required nominal state, and supplies evidence; the agent may collect only approved read-only telemetry.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: One observation of the defined PWM-high phase; the source lists five attended and five machine minutes but gives no duty cycle, high-time, frequency or repeat count.
original_test_intent.expected_result: The LED color, illumination and temporal behavior during the high phase exactly match the target PSU's approved PWM LED specification, with no unexpected PSU, BMC, host or power-health change.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: PSU identity/spec revision, authoritative definition of PWM-high and expected LED response, setup/fixture or configuration identity, synchronized trace or state record plus LED photo/video, operator/time, pre/post PSU/BMC/SEL health and restoration evidence.
ambiguities: The source does not define whether PWM-high denotes a programmed LED descriptor high interval, an internal controller state or an external signal, and it gives no method to establish/correlate that state.
No expected color/on-off behavior, high-time, low-time, duty/frequency, observation tolerance or repeat count is supplied.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 correctly forbids guessed GPIO/PMBus/PWM writes and protects physical observation, logs and recovery. It treats missing setup parameters as an irreducible BLOCKED condition and assumes an externally driven electrical PWM input, even though the source does not establish that interface and later user feedback reclassified the clear physical purpose as MANUAL ONLY.

applicable_history.decision: An earlier gate re-review retained BLOCKED because PWM stimulus parameters and expected response were absent.

The later user-feedback re-review explicitly reclassified this case to MANUAL ONLY, stated that the purpose is clear, and recorded no irreducible blocked condition; the operator establishes/confirms PWM-high and observes the bezel LED.
Later user-confirmed classification boundaries outrank earlier over-BLOCKED missing-input logic unless new evidence proves a different test intent.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: V3 preserves the later user-confirmed MANUAL ONLY boundary. The visual PWM-high LED purpose is understandable; missing owner-specific state generation, timing and expected response prevent current execution but are readiness inputs, not a permanent semantic blocker. No generic electrical PWM drive is inferred.

available_now: The target phenomenon is a physical PSU LED response during a PWM-high state and requires direct operator visual evidence.

Official OCP M-CRPS v1.00 RC4 shows a possible configuration context: LED descriptor Style value 5 is PWM and the descriptor contains PWM THigh/TLow fields, but target applicability is not established.
Read-only PSU/BMC identity, current health and log baselines can be preserved before any state is established.
missing_inputs: Exact PSU/model/firmware and the governing LED/PWM specification revision
Owner definition of PWM-high for this case, including whether it is a descriptor phase, controller state or signal, and the approved method to establish and prove it
Expected LED color/on-off/temporal response and timing/tolerance/repeat requirement
Qualified operator, any fixture/tool/configuration with version/calibration, synchronized observation method, approval, nominal restoration and recovery
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: The PSU/platform owner defines PWM-high, expected LED response and applicability; the PSU vendor supplies any configuration/fixture procedure; the lab owner supplies the qualified operator, observation setup, approval and recovery coverage.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Inventory the exact PSU and firmware/VPD identity and preserve BMC/SEL/host health without clearing logs
Review the supplied LED/PWM document and setup offline; prepare synchronized stimulus-state and video evidence fields without applying a state
prohibited_until_closed: Do not guess or drive a pin, GPIO, PMBus/I2C register, descriptor value or connector, and do not assume generic voltage/current/polarity/duty/frequency parameters
Do not claim to see the LED remotely, infer its physical behavior from logs alone, clear evidence, operate an unverified fixture or reset/reflash/power-cycle outside the approved recovery procedure
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: The owner signs the exact meaning of PWM-high, method, expected LED response and tolerance; target/setup identities are verified; the operator/camera correlation and nominal restoration are demonstrated safely; approval and recovery are active.

revision_candidate.test_name: CRPS LED Behavior During Approved PWM-High State
revision_candidate.purpose: Directly observe and record the target PSU LED while the platform-defined PWM-high phase/state is active, then compare its color and temporal behavior with the exact approved specification.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The exact CRPS PSU model/firmware and platform implementation with an owner-approved PWM definition/setup, qualified physical operator and synchronized observation path.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Only the identified PSU LED and the defined PWM-high condition. Do not substitute BMC telemetry for visual evidence or infer an undocumented electrical/control interface.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: PSU identity; governing LED/PWM spec; definition and proof of high state; approved state-generation/confirmation method; expected LED response and timing tolerance; fixture/tool/configuration details; operator/camera; protected evidence path; approval; restoration/recovery.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: No remote command alone completes this test. Preserve health evidence, have the qualified operator establish or confirm the exact approved PWM-high condition without guessing the interface, capture synchronized setup/state proof and direct LED video/photo for the required interval, remove or restore the condition through the approved method, and collect post-health/log evidence.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Target/spec/state semantics and expected response approved; setup verified and calibrated where applicable; qualified operator and direct view available; safe power/isolation and restoration defined; evidence timing synchronized; logs preserved; recovery owner ready.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: PSU/spec/setup identity; approved high-state parameters or descriptor interpretation; fixture/configuration output proving the interval; timestamped direct LED photo/video showing color/state/timing; operator record; pre/post PSU/BMC/SEL/host evidence; nominal restoration.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The exact PSU/platform LED PWM specification and approved setup procedure. OCP M-CRPS v1.00 RC4 Table 12-49 may be used only if the owner confirms applicability to the target implementation.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Never invent the PWM source or parameters, make undocumented control writes, probe blindly, expose credentials, clear logs, claim visual evidence from telemetry, continue after abnormal power/PSU behavior or perform unapproved reset/reflash/power-cycle recovery.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: The platform owner approves the PWM meaning/setup/expected response. A qualified operator performs or confirms the physical state and direct visual observation; the end user adjudicates PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Establishing any physical setup and directly observing/attesting LED behavior are manual. The agent may prepare the evidence plan and collect approved read-only PSU/BMC telemetry after operator confirmation.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On unexpected LED, PSU, BMC, host or power behavior, stop the approved stimulus/configuration only as documented, preserve synchronized evidence, restore nominal state, verify health and escalate; do not improvise reset or power recovery.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Unresolved PWM meaning, wrong PSU/spec, missing expected response, unverified setup, absent operator/direct view, unsafe or unstable power, state-correlation loss, unexpected PSU/BMC/host behavior, incomplete video/trace, failed nominal restoration or unavailable recovery.

identified_defects: V2 converts missing provisionable setup/criteria into BLOCKED despite the later user-confirmed MANUAL ONLY boundary.
V2 assumes a generic external electrical PWM stimulus although the source does not name a pin/interface; official M-CRPS shows a possible LED-descriptor PWM context.
The source lacks the expected visual behavior and an auditable correlation between the high state and photo/video.
reason_for_change: Honor the later user-confirmed physical/manual classification, separate provisionable missing inputs from capability, and remove V2's unproven assumption that PWM-high necessarily means an external electrical input.

new_technical_evidence.title: M-CRPS Base Specification R1 version 1p00 RC4
new_technical_evidence.version: Open Compute Project M-CRPS Version 1.00 Release Candidate 4; accessed 2026-10-13
new_technical_evidence.applicability: Candidate context only when the target PSU/platform owner confirms this revision
new_technical_evidence.supports: Section 12.8.3.1 Table 12-49 defines LED descriptor Style 5 as PWM and includes PWM THigh [13:12] and PWM TLow [15:14] timing encodings, demonstrating that PWM semantics can be configuration-defined rather than a generic guessed external input.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The source does not identify its governing spec or whether this case tests descriptor timing, an internal state or another platform-specific control.

removed_ambiguities: Does not equate missing state-generation details with an incomprehensible purpose.
Does not claim that PWM-high is a generic electrical pin; makes owner definition and synchronized proof mandatory.
resolved_blockers: The later user-feedback decision establishes that physical execution is MANUAL ONLY and that missing setup/expected response are inputs to be supplied rather than irreducible semantic blockers.
remaining_blockers: The test is not ready to execute until the owner defines PWM-high, supplies the approved method and expected LED response, and provides an operator/observation/recovery path.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 corrects V2's over-BLOCKED classification using the later user-confirmed decision, preserves every no-guess safety restriction, and uses official M-CRPS evidence to avoid asserting an undocumented external PWM interface while requiring auditable high-state-to-video correlation.

agent_understanding_result.notes: The BLOCKED-to-MANUAL ONLY correction and PWM semantic boundary are queued for isolated validation.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: The row requires direct checking of PSU LED status during PWM High state and photo/log evidence.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 safely prohibits guessing but calls missing provisionable inputs BLOCKED and assumes an electrical input; later user feedback explicitly sets MANUAL ONLY.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: No PWM pin/register/descriptor action is allowed until the owner defines it; a qualified operator must correlate the approved high state with direct LED video and nominal restoration.
